market.rules_primary: If the Nasdaq 100 index value on Dec 31, 2026 at 4pm EST is between 29500 and 29999.99, then the market resolves to Yes.
market.rules_secondary:
The market will close on December 31, 2026. The market will expire at the sooner of the first release of the data, or one week after December 31, 2026.

Pursuant to the Kalshi Rulebook, the Exchange has modified the Source Agency and Underlying for indices markets. See the rules for more information.
market.subtitle: 29,500 to 29,999.99
market.title: Will the Nasdaq-100 be between 29500 and 29999.99 at the end of Dec 31, 2026 at 4pm EST?

trims.reason: --max-bars=96: the store keeps the newest 96 bar(s) so an intraday series cannot grow without bound. Oldest bars are dropped and recorded here, never silently.
